mapper.update: UPDATE ra_ai_export_audit SET generation_status='READY',generated_at_ms=#{now},file_rows=#{fileRows},file_bytes=#{fileBytes} WHERE id=#{id} AND actor_doctor_id=#{actorDoctorId} AND generation_status='PREPARING' AND transfer_status='NOT_STARTED' AND error_code IS NULL

UPDATE ra_ai_export_audit SET transfer_status='STARTED',transfer_started_at_ms=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND actor_doctor_id=#{actorDoctorId} AND generation_status='READY' AND transfer_status='NOT_STARTED' AND error_code IS NULL AND file_rows IS NOT NULL AND file_bytes IS NOT NULL

UPDATE ra_ai_export_audit SET transfer_status='WRITTEN',finished_at_ms=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND actor_doctor_id=#{actorDoctorId} AND generation_status='READY' AND transfer_status='STARTED' AND error_code IS NULL

UPDATE ra_ai_export_audit SET transfer_status='REJECTED',error_code=#{errorCode},finished_at_ms=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND actor_doctor_id=#{actorDoctorId} AND generation_status='READY' AND transfer_status='NOT_STARTED' AND error_code IS NULL

UPDATE ra_ai_export_audit SET generation_status='FAILED',error_code=#{errorCode},finished_at_ms=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND actor_doctor_id=#{actorDoctorId} AND generation_status='PREPARING' AND transfer_status='NOT_STARTED' AND error_code IS NULL

UPDATE ra_ai_export_audit SET transfer_status='FAILED',error_code='RESPONSE_WRITE_FAILED',finished_at_ms=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND actor_doctor_id=#{actorDoctorId} AND generation_status='READY' AND transfer_status='STARTED' AND error_code IS NULL
